name: Zajchik: Oskolki Dushi
source:
The plot revolves around three characters: Kostya Sikurov, Alisa Chujkina, and Anton Petrov:
- Kostya Sikurov — "The Outcast"
- Alice Chuykina — "The Two-Souled"
- Anton Petrov — "The Four-Eyed Rooster"

The narrative is driven by Kostya, a boy around 14 years old. It focuses on his attempts to remember what happened to him in the village in the past. Alisa's storyline reveals her character and sheds light on her past, as well as her connections with Kostya. Anton's storyline is unremarkable. In essence, Anton is the antagonist of this mod.

[Translated from [url=https://zaichik-fanon.fandom.com/ru/wiki/%D0%97%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BA:_%D0%9E%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%B4%D1%83%D1%88%D0%B8]Zaichik Fanon[/url]]
translation:
剧情围绕三个角色展开：克斯特亚·西库洛夫 (Kostya Sikurov)、艾莉莎·楚基纳 (Alisa Chujkina) 和安东·彼得罗夫 (Anton Petrov)：
——克斯特亚·西库洛夫——《被放逐者》
——爱丽丝·丘伊基娜——《双魂》
——安东·彼得罗夫——《四眼公鸡》故事由一名14岁左右的男孩科斯特亚 (Kostya) 主导。它的重点是他试图回忆过去在村里发生的事情。艾丽莎的故事情节揭示了她的性格，揭示了她的过去，以及她与克斯特亚的关系。安东的故事情节并不引人注目。本质上，安东是这个mod的对手。

[译自[url=https://zaichik-fanon.fandom.com/ru/wiki/%D0%97%D0%B0%D0%B9%D1%87%D0%B8%D0%BA:_%D0%9E%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BA%D0%B8_%D0%B4%D1%83%D1%88%D0%B8]Zaichik Fanon[/url]]
